description: This file defines an Android Fragment class 'BasicAndroidKeyStoreFragment' that manages cryptographic key generation, signing, and verification using Android Keystore System. It provides methods to create keys, sign data, and verify signatures, handling different Android platform versions.

classes.name: BasicAndroidKeyStoreFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment handling cryptographic key creation, data signing, and signature verification using Android Keystore.

methods.name: createKeys
methods.description: Generates a public/private key pair and stores it in Android Keystore with parameters depending on Android version.

methods.name: signData
methods.description: Signs input data with the stored private key and returns a Base64-encoded signature string.

methods.name: verifyData
methods.description: Verifies input data against a provided signature using the stored public key.
